article.hook: You see a plan, and every muscle starts pulling - it’s like the rest of the world is noise until you get results. Mars in Capricorn pushes you into action that’s all about grinding down obstacles and building something that lasts.
article.lived: Over the next six weeks, drive feels like a slow burn in your bones. You map out the next steps with laser focus and chip away at them every day. The rush comes not from speed but from the quiet proof of progress - an email sent, a call made, a problem solved with no fuss. You don’t waste energy on hype; you make every move count and keep your eye on the scoreboard.
article.turn: The danger arrives when the mountain is all you see and rest becomes a stranger. You push so hard that patience turns into stubbornness, and ambition morphs into grinding for grinding’s sake. The work stops being a path to something and becomes a punishment you keep handing yourself - cut the climb when the summit is nothing but another peak to scale.
moves: Outline one goal you can finish this week and schedule time for it in your calendar.
